definitions.explanation: Refers to a range of different things or circumstances. A formal word used primarily in written Japanese to indicate multiple factors or considerations.

examples.japanese: {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}します→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧。
examples.english: It will be canceled due to various circumstances.

examples.japanese: {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}した→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: We will make a decision after considering the various circumstances.

examples.japanese: {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑|かんが}み→鑑みる：14472_kangamiru⟧、⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧{日|び}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: In light of various circumstances, we will be changing the date of the event.

notes:
A formal word meaning 'various' or 'all sorts of,' composed of ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ (various, many) and {般|はん} (kind, sort). Almost always appears in the fixed phrase {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ (various circumstances), which is commonly used in official announcements to explain cancellations, changes, or decisions without giving specific reasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: various circumstances (the most frequent collocation)
- {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: various conditions
- {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: due to various circumstances
- {諸般|しょはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑|かんが}み→鑑みる：14472_kangamiru⟧: in light of various circumstances

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な: various — neutral, used in both spoken and written Japanese
- ⟦{種々|しゅじゅ}→種々：08730_shuju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: various, assorted — formal, written; interchangeable in some contexts
- {諸|もろもろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: various, all sorts of — formal but slightly less stiff than {諸般|しょはん}

REGISTER:
Highly formal. Appears in official notices, press releases, and business correspondence. In everyday speech, ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧な or ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な would be used instead.
